author: Praxis VI
title: Ablation: Praxis X_emb + PBVE-lite + scanpy.neighbors (k=50, cosine)
abstract: Apply PBVE-lite equalization to the Praxis GraphFWPCA embedding, then construct a kNN graph with scanpy.neighbors to test embedding-space PBVE as a complement to GraphFWPCA.

original_submission.content:
import sys
import anndata as ad
sys.path.append('storage/praxis')
# Equalize per-batch per-PC variance on Praxis embedding, then kNN via scanpy.neighbors
from embedding_fwpca_pbve_knn import eliminate_batch_effect_fn as _run

def eliminate_batch_effect_fn(adata: ad.AnnData) -> ad.AnnData:
    return _run(adata)
